newsitem.title: USA: Foodbrands sees Q3, Q4 EPS down or flat.
newsitem.headline: Foodbrands sees Q3, Q4 EPS down or flat.

text.p: Foodbrands America Inc said on Thursday higher raw material costs would hold back earnings in the third and fourth quarters.
It said in a statement it expected earnings for the rest of the year would either show little change or to decline.
The company expects third-quarter earnings per share to fall between $0.14 and $0.16 and fourth-quarter EPS to fall between $0.21 to $0.26.
Foodbrands earned $0.20 per share and $0.27 per share in the third and fourth quarters last year, respectively.

The company said it was forced to lower its earnings forecasts because of higher-than-expected raw material costs, which were affecting the entire industry. Higher pork prices created some margin pressure, it said.
Foodbrands said it was still experiencing sales and volume growth in line with expectations. Cost reduction was also on track, it said.
Profit margin pressure was expected to persist for the rest of the year, the company said.

Foodbrands said its Foodbrands Americas Specialty Brands division also was not performing as well as expected. The unit's operating income was being hurt by competition, particularly in the appetizer business, it said.
